<subject>Fw: Reclassification of Treasury Income</subject>
<body>
FYI - If this request is approved, the reclassification/reporting of Treasury Income within Other Income-Other should result in an additional £400K to Pre-Tax Profit for 2024 (Credit Risk £300K, Corporate Lending £100K).
</body>
<quoted>
 -----Original Message-----
From: 	Evans, Josh  
Sent:	Thursday, 19 September 2024 10:43 AM
To:	Marsh, Donald
Subject:	FW: Reclassification of Treasury Income


fyi
 -----Original Message-----
From: 	Evans, Josh  
Sent:	Thursday, 19 September 2024 10:40 AM
To:	Perkins, Jonathan; Robertson, Gemma
Cc:	Walters Jr., Paul; Smith, Ryan; Marshall, Robert; Carey, Howard; Graham, Amanda; Johnson, Valerie; Hughes, Dylan; Walters, Russell; Coleman, Maurice
Subject:	Reclassification of Treasury Income


Request to reclassify the below two ledger accounts for Treasury Income from account 4210 (Other Income) to account 4110 (Other Income - Other)               Effective: for September 2024 Close.

     Ledger Accounts      Description                             From: Current Mapping              To: New Mapping
          12345678     Treasury Income Settlement                4210_12345678                     4110_12345678
          98765432     Treasury Income                                 4210_98765432                     4110_98765432


Treasury Income (ledger accounts 12345678-Treasury Income Settlement and 98765432-Treasury Income) currently map to Halcyon's 4210-Other Income.  The only business units using these two ledger accounts as of July and the YTD credit balances in each of them are units 141-£305,115, 179-£189,020, 413-£-7,391 (debit), 536-£1,753,019, 60-£52,691 and 62-£167,019.

In conclusion I have reviewed the proposed reclassification with representatives of the various business units and they confirmed the reclassification would not present any problems to them.

PS.   Pls notify me or Maurice Coleman when change is made in Leeds so he can reclassify same accounts in our system. 
</quoted>
